title: 第7章 白嫖的感觉确实不错第8章 突破炼体境八重再被剑宗除名
lines: 离开了萧家的萧诺，独自走在晰月城的街道上，望着这繁华的道路，其内心有种说不出来的复杂。
今日所做之事，既有报复后的快感，但同样也为往后累积下了祸患。
萧诺很清楚，萧雄不会放过自己。
不过这已经无所谓了，毕竟在前几天，萧永就已经想要自己的性命了。
即便自己今天不来，也已经和萧家彻底撕破了脸皮。
临近傍晚时分……
萧诺来到了一座富丽堂皇的高楼门口。
这座高楼装修的极为奢华，朱红色的石柱，青玉色的砖瓦，看上去第一眼，就令人感受到了气派。
“万羽楼！”
门口的牌匾上，三个金光闪闪的大字很是耀眼。
万羽楼的背后乃是“万金商会”
，而万金商会的背后，便是晰月城五大家族之一的公孙家族。
公孙家族的生意是做的非常大的，这万羽楼也是商会的一大交易会所。
下到金银珠宝，上到武器丹药，但凡有价值的东西，都可以在里边进行兑换。
萧诺进了万羽楼的大门。
一名三十几岁的中年男人接待了他，这中年男人细眯着眼角，给人一种狐狸的狡黠感。
“客人是来买东西吗？”
他和善的笑道。
萧诺看着对方：“我来卖东西。”
中年男人有些意外，从萧诺的穿着打扮来看，他有些怀疑对方能拿出什么有价值的东西。
“你要卖什么？”
萧诺随手取出一部卷轴递给中年男人，后者也是随手接了过来，可当他翻开第一页的时候，脸色骤然一变，然后立即把卷轴合上：“你，你，你要卖掉这个？”
萧诺平静的回视对方：“你们收吗？”
中年男人警惕的看了眼四周，并小声说道：“借一步说话！”
萧诺点点头。
不一会儿，两人来到了一个无人的雅间。
中年男人盯着萧诺：“这部《飞影剑诀》可是天罡剑宗的上品武学，你胆敢拿来交易，是嫌活的太久了吗？”
萧诺要卖的东西，正是白天在萧家得到的《飞影剑诀》。
当然了，在来之前，萧诺已经抄了一部副本。
武学功法乃是宗门机密，这《飞影剑诀》达到了上品，哪怕是在天罡剑宗，也只有内门级别的弟子有资格修炼。
这次天罡剑宗把它传授给萧永，是为数不多的破例。
但如果未经宗门允许，就把武学外传，那是重罪。
content_en:
Xiao Nuo, who had left the Xiao family, was walking alone on the streets of Xiyue City. Looking at the bustling roads, there was an indescribable complexity in his heart.
What you do today not only brings you the pleasure of revenge, but it also creates trouble for the future.
Xiao Nuo knew very well that Xiao Xiong would not let him go.
But it doesn't matter anymore, after all, Xiao Yong already wanted his own life a few days ago.
Even if he doesn't come today, he has already completely broken up with the Xiao family.
It's approaching evening...
Xiao Nuo came to the door of a magnificent high-rise building.
This high-rise building is extremely luxuriously decorated, with vermilion stone pillars and sapphire-colored bricks and tiles. It makes people feel the grandeur at first glance.
"Wan Yu Tower!"
On the plaque at the door, three large golden characters are very dazzling.
Behind Wanyu Tower is the "Wanjin Chamber of Commerce"
, and behind the Wanjin Chamber of Commerce is the Gongsun family, one of the five major families in Xiyue City.
The Gongsun family's business is very large, and Wanyu Tower is also a major trading center of the Chamber of Commerce.
From gold and silver jewelry to weapons and elixirs, anything of value can be exchanged there.
Xiao Nuo entered the gate of Wanyu Tower.
A middle-aged man in his thirties received him. This middle-aged man narrowed his eyes, giving people a cunning feeling like a fox.
"Are the guests here to buy something?"
He smiled kindly.
Xiao Nuo looked at the other party: "I'm here to sell things."
"Oh?"
The middle-aged man was a little surprised. Judging from Xiao Nuo's dress, he doubted that the other party could bring out anything valuable.
"What are you selling?"
"This..."
Xiao Nuo casually took out a scroll and handed it to the middle-aged man. The latter took it casually, but when he turned the first page, his expression suddenly changed, and he immediately closed the scroll: "You, you, you want to sell this?"
Xiao Nuo looked back at the other party calmly: "Do you accept it?"
The middle-aged man looked around warily and whispered, "Take a step to speak!"
Xiao Nuo nodded.
After a while, the two came to an empty private room.
The middle-aged man stared at Xiao Nuo: "This "Flying Shadow Sword Technique" is the top-grade martial arts of Tiangang Sword Sect. If you dare to trade it, do you think you have lived too long?"
What Xiao Nuo wants to sell is the "Flying Shadow Sword Art" that he got at Xiao's house during the day.
Of course, Xiao Nuo had already copied a copy before coming here.
Martial arts skills are a secret of the sect. This "Flying Shadow Sword Technique" has reached the top level. Even in the Tiangang Sword Sect, only inner sect-level disciples are qualified to practice it.
This time the Tiangang Sword Sect taught it to Xiao Yong, which was one of the few exceptions.
But if one spreads martial arts without the sect's permission, that is a serious crime.
